title: Add regression coverage for negative checkout tax
description: Add a focused regression test proving that orderTotalCents rejects a negative tax rate. This is a controlled failure probe: only modify lab/coding-task/src/checkout-negative-tax.test.js, do not change checkout.js, and leave the product implementation unchanged. The test is expected to fail because negative-tax validation is not currently part of orderTotalCents. The purpose is to verify that Klin records failed model work and retry usage separately from successful work.
